ModMetaData.name: Essencebound v0.11 — RimWorld 1.7
ModMetaData.author: Essencebound Project
ModMetaData.description: Essencebound v0.11 experimental RimWorld 1.7 prototype: individual ability progression, essence rank milestones, per-pawn weighted random Power/Speed/Spirit/Recovery affinities, a four-essence profile, and configurable 2-5 ability slots. Requires Essencebound.Core.dll in 1.7/Assemblies. Use test saves and report errors.
